title: OSAC Assesses CJNG Retains Organizational Cohesion After El Mencho's Death
detail: The Overseas Security Advisory Council (OSAC) assessed that no large-scale breakup of CJNG has occurred following El Mencho's death, suggesting the cartel retains organizational structure and command continuity. The assessment reflects broader U.S. government analysis that CJNG's hierarchical structure and regional command network have absorbed the leadership decapitation without fragmenting into competing factions.
